title: Revamp Console RBAC & Audit Log: integrated org/workspace settings and cost-aware role views
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: unify Organization and Workspace settings surfaces to make role assignment, permission previews, and audit history discoverable in a single admin flow. Deliverables: high-fidelity prototypes for the Roles page, Role Details panel, Access Review modal, and an Audit Log explorer that surfaces cost-relevant activity (model served, tokens, route). This ticket covers UX decisions, prototype handoff, and usability test findings needed for the engineering implementation. Constraints: needs to work in both Hosted and Dedicated contexts, respect per-workspace RBAC overrides, and integrate with existing Console rollout controls (canary/A-B) without exposing raw infra details.
acceptance_criteria: Design specs delivered for Roles list, Role detail, Access Review modal, and Audit Log explorer
Prototype demonstrates permission preview and simulated 'what-if' granting of permissions without saving
Cost column added to audit entries showing approximate token cost per activity where available
Edge cases documented for cross-workspace admins and delegated support roles
Usability test with 6 participants shows >80% task success on: creating a role, running access review, and exporting audit CSV
comments: 2026-02-12 Maya Chen: Initial kickoff with PM and Eng. Agreed scope to include cost fields in audit log and a permission preview feature that won't change backend entitlements (read-only in the prototype).

2026-02-18 Oliver Park: Wireframes v1 posted. Key trade-off: permission preview complexity vs clarity. Suggested a simplified table (capability x resource) with hover tooltips instead of full grammar-based permission builder.
2026-02-22 Priya (PM): Requested inclusion of 'last used' timestamp per role and an ability to mark roles as 'deprecated' for org-level cleanup flows.
2026-02-25 Design critique: Ruth highlighted need for clear audit retention indicator and export controls to meet compliance. Added an 'export retention policy' note to the spec.

2026-03-04 Usability tests (prototype v2): 6 participants (3 infra admins, 2 product managers, 1 security analyst). Findings: users expected cost numbers to be aggregated by time window; confusion when role inheritance is implicit. Action: add explicit inheritance breadcrumb and a small help tooltip linking to RBAC docs.

2026-03-09 Diego (Eng): Feasibility note — live permission preview will need a sandboxed evaluation API (ENG-2912). We decided to ship read-only simulated preview first and add live check in a follow-up iteration.

2026-03-11 Ruth (Security): Approved visual affordances for audit severity and recommended storing exported logs to the existing secure S3 export path. Security review initiated (stated under PM ticket).

2026-03-12 Oliver Park: Updated handoff package (Figma frames + annotated component tokens + Slack thread). Marking ticket ready for dev handoff but leaving in 'In Review' until PM confirms final wording on 'cost estimates' language.
decisions: Show cost as an estimated token-cost and USD approximation with a disclaimer; link to cost breakdown tool for exact numbers.
Permission preview will be read-only v1 using deterministic rules; live entitlement checks deferred to ENG-2912.
Audit Log will offer quick filters: actor, role, workspace, model, time window, and cost threshold; CSV export will include cost column and role context.
Access Review flow will include automated suggestions for stale roles (last_used > 90 days) and a one-click start-review modal pre-populated with affected members.
UI will surface role inheritance explicitly with 'inherited from' breadcrumbs to avoid implicit surprises when revoking permissions.
tradeoffs: Including precise cost requires backend aggregation; we use estimated per-event token cost in v1 to avoid blocking on infra work.
A full permission grammar editor is powerful but increases cognitive load; chose a simplified matrix view for faster comprehension.
Exporting audit data with PII redaction is a compliance requirement; initial export will redact sensitive fields and include a notice. Full redaction rules will be implemented by security team later.
implementation_notes: Frontend: new RolesList and RoleDetail components under console/ui/roles; uses existing table and tag components for consistency.
Backend: requires audit log index to include model_id and token_estimate fields (dependency ENG-2890).
Handoff: Annotated Figma frames include interaction specs and all component tokens; also included CSS token references for spacing and color states.
Rollout plan: feature-flag gated on org-level beta; opt-in via Workspace settings. Gradual rollout based on org size and internal beta usage.
accessibility_considerations: All interactive elements include ARIA labels; role matrix rows are keyboard navigable; color contrast checked for severity badges; tooltips accessible via focus. We will add screen-reader friendly summaries for exported CSV headers.
qa_checks: Verify role creation honors workspace override rules
Confirm permission preview does not alter entitlements
Audit log filters return results within 3s for 90th percentile test dataset
CSV export contains cost column and respects redaction policies
next_steps: Engineering sync to confirm audit index schema and export paths (ENG-2890)
Security sign-off on export redaction and retention language
Schedule rollout plan with Growth for early adopter orgs
